questions.subject: physics
questions.stem: A car accelerates uniformly from rest at $2.5\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$ for $8.0\ \mathrm{s}$.

steps.prompt: Calculate the final speed in m/s.
Calculate the distance travelled in metres.

partial.note: You used final speed x time. The car was speeding up, so use the average speed (or s = 1/2 a t^2).

steps.prompt: Calculate the average speed in m/s.

questions.subject: physics
questions.stem: A sound wave of frequency $170\ \mathrm{Hz}$ travels at $340\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$ in air.

steps.prompt: Calculate the period in seconds (3 s.f.). You may write it like 5.88e-3.
The frequency is changed to 680 Hz in the same air. State the new wavelength in metres.

questions.subject: physics
questions.stem: A $6\ \Omega$ and a $3\ \Omega$ resistor are connected **in parallel** across a $12\ \mathrm{V}$ supply.

steps.prompt: Calculate the combined resistance in ohms.
Calculate the total current in amperes.
Calculate the current through the 6 ohm resistor in amperes.
steps.hint: Each branch has the full 12 V across it.

questions.subject: physics
questions.stem: A fixed mass of gas at constant volume is heated from $300\ \mathrm{K}$ to $600\ \mathrm{K}$. What happens to its pressure?

options.trap: Pressure rises with temperature at constant volume.
Inverts the relationship: pressure is proportional to T, not 1/T.
Squares the ratio; the relationship is linear, $p\propto T$.

questions.subject: physics
questions.stem: A $80\ \mathrm{mg}$ sample of an isotope has a half-life of $6.0$ hours.

steps.prompt: State the mass remaining after 12 hours in mg.
State the mass remaining after 18 hours in mg.
State the fraction of the sample remaining after 24 hours as a decimal.
